subject: Novagen private deployment — edge integration cadence
messages:

Cc: devops@novagen.com, marco.bianchi@novagen.com
Date: 2028-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment kickoff + network info request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Novagen is excited to move forward with a private deployment (VPC peering + private endpoints + the on-prem appliance). Before we lock in dates, our platform/security leads asked for a clear onboarding cadence and the specific network inventory you need from us.

Can you confirm:
- A short checklist of items we should collect before the first install window (IP ranges, firewall rules, certs, KMS access pattern).
- Recommended blackout windows for minimal production impact.
- Any on-prem packaging/space/power requirements that our facilities team should prep.

I've attached our preliminary network diagrams (see placeholder: novagen-vpc-diagram.v1.png) and looped in Marco and the DevOps alias.

Looking forward to a short kickoff call — are you available next Tuesday afternoon PT?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Infrastructure
Novagen Therapeutics

--
Attachments: novagen-vpc-diagram.v1.png (PNG image, 842 KB)
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novagen.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment kickoff + network info request

Elena — thanks for the diagram and clear list. High level answers below; I'll attach a more prescriptive template for your network team.

1) Pre-kickoff inventory checklist (short):
   - CIDR blocks for VPCs (prod/staging), NAT & peering IPs
   - Public IPs (if any) for egress allow-lists
   - CIDR and hostname for private endpoints
   - TLS certs (server) or plan to use our managed TLS flow
   - KMS/HSM contact & key policy for envelope encryption (if using customer-managed keys)
   - Contact for on-prem site lead + onsite SSH jump host plan

2) Blackout windows:
   - For initial cutover we recommend a 2-hour maintenance window in low-traffic hours (we typically suggest 01:00–03:00 PT for US West customers).
   - A longer 4–6 hour window may be required if we need hardware-level work during the on-prem appliance install.

3) On-prem packaging & facilities:
   - 1U or 2U rack space (we will confirm exact SKU once finalizing the appliance), 2x10GbE ports, dual power with PDUs.

Attachments included: network_inventory_template.csv (CSV) and onprem_install_manifest.pdf (PDF) — the CSV has the precise fields your network team should populate.

I've looped in Marissa (CS lead) to coordinate the overall implementation timeline and Aditya for networking specifics. Proposed next step: 30-minute technical kickoff on Tue 2028-06-05 14:00 PT — does that work for you?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: network_inventory_template.csv (CSV template), onprem_install_manifest.pdf (PDF manifest)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novagen.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-31T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment kickoff + network info request

Elena — great to meet you virtually. I'll own the implementation plan and run the cadence with your delivery manager. High-level rollout we propose: 

Week 0 (Prep) — collect inventory + confirm access
Week 1 (Staging) — deploy private endpoints in staging, run validation tests
Week 2 (On-prem install) — appliance install and connectivity validation
Week 3 (Cutover & smoke) — production peering and verification

Please confirm a single point of contact from Novagen for change approvals and that we have access to any internal ticketing items we need to reference.

On the blackout windows: we can minimize customer-facing impact by performing most network prep in staging and then using a short maintenance window for the production cutover. If you anticipate additional compliance reviews (SOC2 evidence), loop Vivek who will gather the audit artifacts.

I will prepare a short mutual action plan and share before the kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

--
(Attachment referenced in-line: mutual_action_plan_draft.docx — will share during kickoff)

Hi team,

Following Naomi's template, here's an explicit networking checklist we need filled out prior to any scheduled install. I've pasted it below and attached the CSV template for convenience.

Required items (networking):
- Production VPC CIDR: ___________
- Staging VPC CIDR: ___________
- Peering connection name & region: ___________
- BGP ASN (if using routed peering) or static routes: ___________
- Private endpoint FQDN(s) for model endpoints: ___________
- DNS delegation plan (will we create private hosted zones?) : ___________
- Firewall egress/ingress ports: 443 outbound to Redwood IP ranges (list in CSV) + 22 for appliance management (if using SSH jump host)
- TLS cert format (PEM/PFX) & expiry date: ___________
- KMS key ARN and key policy contact: ___________
- Proxy / HTTP inspection in path? (yes/no) + bypass list: ___________

Notes on appliance access: we request a temporary jump-host that allows our install engineer to fetch installation packages and push configuration. Persistent management access can be disabled after handoff.

Please return the completed CSV by EOD Friday 2028-06-02 so we can finalize the install manifest.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Network Integration Engineer
Redwood Inference
